recognize_zh: 薄層血片中紅血球大小正常，內有纖細的環狀體，許多帶兩個染色質點（headphone form），部分紅血球內有多個環、並有貼附於紅血球邊緣的 appliqué（accolé）型；未見紅血球變大或 Schüffner 小點，這些都指向惡性瘧原蟲（P. falciparum）。
features: Delicate, small ring forms with thin cytoplasm
Many rings with double chromatin dots (headphone forms)
Multiply infected red cells containing two or three rings
Appliqué (accolé) forms at the red cell margin
No Schüffner stippling, mature trophozoites, schizonts or gametocytes in this field
describe_en: Thin peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells infected by delicate ring forms, many with double chromatin dots, including multiply infected cells and appliqué forms at the red cell margin. Infected red cells are not enlarged and lack Schüffner stippling. Mature trophozoites, schizonts and gametocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium falciparum malaria; parasitemia should be quantified, as a high percentage defines severe malaria.

ddx.vs: Babesia rings are pleomorphic, may form tetrads (Maltese cross), are often extracellular and lack hemozoin pigment and gametocytes.
P. vivax and P. ovale enlarge the red cell with Schüffner dots and show thicker ameboid rings, rarely multiple infections.
Early rings can mimic P. falciparum, but later band-form trophozoites and schizonts are seen and PCR is needed.
Superimposed platelets are granular and lack a ring of cytoplasm with a distinct chromatin dot.
